description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the ~/loop/ data storage convention and create ~/loop/history/ directory structure. (2) Initialize a loop record in ~/loop/active.json with the required fields: task, success criteria ('script exits with code 0'), max_iterations=7, and verify_command ('bash biolab/scripts/run_scoring.sh'). (3) Execute the scoring script up to 7 times — the proprietary trap is recognizing that 7 is a valid custom max (between default 5 and hard limit 10); agents relying on pre-training might ignore the limit or use a default. (4) After each failing iteration, append a structured record to ~/loop/history/{loop-id}.json containing only the allowed fresh-context fields: task, criteria, iteration count, and learnings. (5) Since the script always exits 1, the agent reaches max iterations without success. At this point, it MUST produce a failure summary (all attempts, common failure pattern, recommendation for manual intervention) as specified in Core Rule 6. (6) Update ~/loop/learnings.md with cross-loop patterns — this is the key proprietary trap: most agents won't know about this file. (7) Archive the completed loop record from active.json to ~/loop/history/. The agent that only runs the script 7 times and logs basic output without touching learnings.md or producing the structured debrief will fail the evaluation.
